caption: A leaf is held up against the sun, and its shadow falls on the ground below.

sa.check: A leaf is held up against the sun.
Its shadow falls on the ground below.
The leaf is held up, not lying on the ground.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the surface below, away from the sun, and moves when the leaf moves.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or stays still while the leaf moves; or it is missing in sunlight.

pc.expect: The shadow has the leaf's outline.
pc.fail: It is a different shape; or splits; or it is a plain blob unlike the leaf.

pc.expect: The shadow does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It drifts with the leaf still; or moves before the leaf.

pc.expect: The shadow is joined to the shadow of the hand or stem holding the leaf.
pc.fail: The leaf's shadow floats with no shadow of what holds it; or it is separated from the hand's shadow.
A second leaf or shadow appears; or the leaf vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The leaf's colour and the ground stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The leaf changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the ground changes.

note: The hand holding the leaf is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
